title: Straticate model manifest
description: A logical model entry in the Straticate model catalog. schema_version 1.

architecture.description: Implementation family, e.g. 'mel_band_roformer', 'mdx', 'mdxc', 'demucs', 'fake'. Open set — application code must not branch on it outside the inference package.

development_only.description: True for a development fixture: an entry that exists to exercise the application (CI, the test suite, the E2E tier) and does not perform real separation. Such an entry is excluded from the user-facing catalog unless STRATICATE_INCLUDE_DEVELOPMENT_MODELS is enabled. Omitted means false, so a normal model needs no such field. Marked here, on the manifest, rather than inferred from 'architecture' — that field is an open set application code must not branch on.
development_only.$comment: Declared per entry rather than derived: 'fake' is one architecture today, and a future fixture of any architecture must be markable without a code change.

separation_mode.description: Logical mode ID this model serves, e.g. 'vocals', 'standard_stems'.

quality_tier.description: User-facing quality tier this model backs within its separation mode. Omitted means 'balanced'. Two models in the same separation_mode must not claim the same tier: the tier ID is what a job request's quality_id selects.

requirements.description: Advisory resource figures, surfaced on the public Model resource. Nothing enforces them; they exist so a user can tell whether their hardware is suitable before a 900 MB download.

recommended_vram_mb.description: GPU VRAM in MiB for comfortable use: a full-length track, on a card that is also driving a display. A **measured** whole-device peak plus headroom, not a bound the code enforces — record how it was measured, and at which default_inference_parameters, in the feature document that set it (peak scales with inference.chunk_size and with track length).

minimum_vram_mb.description: GPU VRAM in MiB below which this model should not be attempted on that backend at all — the floor, where recommended_vram_mb is the comfortable figure. Measured the same way. Omit when no meaningful floor is known; a model with no CUDA capability has no use for either field.

capabilities.description: Compute backends this model supports. Open set of backend IDs.

artifact.description: Downloadable weights artifact. Absent for built-in separators (e.g. fake).

default_inference_parameters.description: Architecture-specific defaults (segment size, overlap, batch size, …). Opaque to application code; consumed only by the matching separator implementation.
